title: Combination sum
statementMd:
Distinct positive integers `candidates` can be reused unlimited times. Return all unique combinations (each sorted ascending) that sum to `target`, the list sorted.

**Example:** `combination_sum([2, 3, 6, 7], 7)` returns `[[2, 2, 3], [7]]`.
hints: Recurse with a start index so order is non-decreasing.
